      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies cmake/module/AddBoostIfNeeded.cmake, depends/packages/boost.mk, vcpkg.json, and contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh to eliminate Boost.Test as a build and dependency requirement.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removes the Boost.Test dependency across depends, Guix, CMake, and vcpkg configurations. While simplifying build maintenance and environment setup, it is a non-urgent dependency reduction rather than a fix for broken builds or release-critical tooling."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp are mechanical one-line header updates resulting from the test framework migration.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Mechanical test header changes following a global refactor do not make a PR part of IPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp are mechanical header updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Mechanical edits to kernel test headers following an in-tree runner replacement do not affect the kernel API or its boundaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements an in-tree test runner and expression decomposition assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and adapts main.cpp and test suite entry points.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree framework that outputs decomposed expression values on assertion failure and eliminates long-standing dependency issues (#8670, #34666). It represents a strategically important improvement to developer test ergonomics and enables better static analysis tooling (IWYU, clang-tidy) across the unit test suite."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh belong to the Guix build environment rather than developer or operator tools.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify developer or operator scripts covered by the tools category."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
